sanskrit: divo nabhaḥ śukraṃ payo duhānā- -rtasya nābhir amṛtaṃ vi caṣṭe ||
english: The bright cloud of the sky, milking out its waters — it is the navel of cosmic order (ṛta), and it reveals the immortal nectar.

sanskrit: ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītām ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphurantīm | upāsatāṃ sukṛtaḥ svadhābhiḥ ||
english: Milking out clarified butter drunk in from all sides, milking out nourishing strength unceasingly — may the pious worship her with their offerings.

sanskrit: ghṛtam iccha pinvamānām imāṃ yonim upādhvam | svadhā yāś cakṛṣe jīvan tās te santu madhuścutaḥ ||
english: Seek the ghee in this swelling womb; approach it! Those libations you have made while living — may they drip with sweetness for you.

sanskrit: saṃ rasā oṣadhīnāṃ sam ākūtīr namantu me | ūrjasvantaṃ payasvantaṃ pṛthivyā hastam anv agām ||
english: May the essences of plants and their powers bow together toward me. I have followed the hand of the earth, full of strength and full of sap.

sanskrit: pariṇītir asi hastasya pathaḥ pariṇītir asi | evā ha duṣvapnyaṃ sarvaṃ stambe pari ṇayāmasi ||
english: You are the guide of the path of the hand; you are the guide. Thus do we lead away all evil dreams around the post.

sanskrit: payasvan me kṣetram astu payasvad uta dhānyam | kṛṣiḥ payasvatī mama- -ahaṃ payasvān bhūyāsam ||
english: May my field be rich in sap; may my grain too be rich in sap. My agriculture shall be full of sap — may I myself be full of sap.

sanskrit: vṛṣṇe bṛhate svarvide 'gnaye śuklaṃ harāmi tviṣīmate | sa na sthirān balavataḥ kṛṇotu jyok ca no jīvātave dadhātu ||
english: I bring a white offering to Agni the powerful, the mighty, the finder of the heavenly light, the radiant one. May he make us firm and strong, and grant that we live long.

sanskrit: veda vai te 'gne nāma- -adbhir nāmāsi trivarūthaḥ | trayaḥ poṣās trivṛd asmān yajñaḥ sacatām ||
english: I know your name, O Agni — you are named through the waters; you are the triple-shielded one. May the threefold nourishment, the threefold sacrifice, attend us.

sanskrit: prajāpateḥ payasā vāvṛdhānā āyuṣmanto varcasvinaḥ | jyog jīvanta upa tvā sadema ||
english: Growing strong on the milk of Prajāpati, long-lived and radiant with splendor — may we who live long sit down near you.

sanskrit: urūṇasāv asutṛpā udumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janām̐ anu | vedāhaṃ veda sūryaḥ kim etau kiṃ kariṣyataḥ ||
english: Those two wide-nostriled, life-consuming, ficus-dark messengers of Yama who roam among men — I know them; the sun knows them. What are these two? What will they do?

sanskrit: na mā dadambha dabhasādabhīyaṃ na pāko asmi januṣā na śiṣyaḥ | abhīṣāḍ asmi viśvāṣāṭ pṛtanāṣāṭ svarvid yad idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ so asmi ||
english: No deceiver has beguiled me; I am not to be overcome by the deceitful; I am not naive by birth, nor a disciple still learning. I am the conqueror, the all-conqueror, the vanquisher of armies, the knower of heaven — I am all this universe of beings.

sanskrit: āsthād ud asthād ajaniṣṭa vipro 'mimīta varimāṇaṃ pṛthivyāḥ | āsīdat saṃrāḍ bhuvanāni viśvā sa icchā veda varuṇasya vratāni ||
english: He has stood up, he has risen, the inspired sage was born; he measured out the breadth of the earth. He took his seat as sovereign over all the worlds; he knows by insight the ordinances of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: prajāpatiḥ prajāvān sa mā prajāvān prajāvantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Prajāpati is rich in offspring; he is rich in offspring — may he make me rich in offspring.

sanskrit: sūryo varcasvān sa mā varcasvān varcasvantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: The sun is full of radiant splendor; he is full of splendor — may he make me full of splendor.

sanskrit: somaḥ payasvān sa mā payasvān payasvantaṃ kṛṇotu ||
english: Soma is full of milky sap; he is full of sap — may he make me full of sap.

sanskrit: triṃśan muṣkāḥ kābavasya daśa muṣkā ulūkyāḥ | catvāras tava kardama ||
english: Thirty testicles has the kābava plant; ten testicles the owl-plant has. Four are yours, O muddy one.

sanskrit: tāṃs tvam ugrakāśini mūle api kṛntatāt | āsuro 'si janmanā taṃ tveto nāśayāmasi ||
english: O fierce-shining one, cut them off at the root! You are demonic by birth — we drive that away from here.

sanskrit: indrajā asi somajās taṃ tveto niṣ pra hiṇmasi | urvā matsyo madhūdakaṃ tasya pāsy atyayam anāsrāvam arogaṇam ||
english: You are born of Indra, born of Soma — we send that away from here. O wide fish of sweet waters, you guard its passage — free from discharge, free from disease.

sanskrit: iṣirā cāsy ajirā cāsi | prajāpateḥ samid asi saṃsitir nāma lomaśā | prajāpatiṣ ṭvayā pratiṣṭhākāmo 'ruruta sa praty atiṣṭhat | sa yathā tvayā prajāpatiḥ pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ pratyatiṣṭhad evāhaṃ tvayā pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ prati tiṣṭheṣam | ā mā varo gamed ā mā brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are swift and you are nimble. You are the kindling-wood of Prajāpati, hairy in name, called Saṃsiti. Prajāpati, desiring to become established through you, rose up and became established. Just as Prajāpati, desiring to become established through you, became established, even so may I, desiring to become established through you, become established. May good fortune come to me; may the students of sacred knowledge come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: bhūtiś cāsi pratiṣṭhā cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are prosperity and you are firm establishment. [Prajāpati, desiring to become established through you, rose up and became established. Just as Prajāpati desiring to become established through you became established, even so may I become established. May good fortune come to me; may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: asvapnā cāsy anilayā cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are sleeplessness and you are restlessness. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: ruciś cāsi yakṣaṃ cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are brilliance and you are a wondrous being. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: kīrtiś cāsi yaśaś cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are fame and you are glory. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: ambhaś cāsi mahaś cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are water and you are greatness. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: annaṃ cāsy annādyaṃ cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are food and you are the eating of food. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: prayacchantī cāsi pradadatī cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are the one that proffers and the one that bestows freely. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: anukāmā cāsi kāmadughā cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are the fulfiller of desires and the milker of desires. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: āharantī cāsi samāharantī cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are the one that brings and the one that gathers together. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: diśantī cāsi pradiśantī cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are the one that points the way and the one that points it forth. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: anumatiś cāsy anumanyamānā cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are approval and you are the one who grants approval. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: jitiś cāsi vijitiś cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are conquest and you are victory. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: sañjitiś cāsi sandhanājitaṃ cāsi | prajāpateḥ (…) brahmacāriṇo gameyuḥ svāhā ||
english: You are complete conquest and you are what is won by joining together. [Prajāpati... may the students of sacred knowledge] come to me. Svāhā!

sanskrit: agniḥ pṛthivyā adhipatiḥ somas tvāvatu vidma tvā viddhi mā | adhipatir asy adhipatiṃ mā kṛṇu gavām aśvānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ bhūtyā annādyasya ||
english: Agni is the lord of the earth; may Soma protect you. We know you; know us. You are the overlord — make me the overlord of cattle, horses, men, students of sacred knowledge, of prosperity and the eating of food.

sanskrit: vāyur antarikṣasyādhipatiḥ somas (…) annādyasya ||
english: Vāyu is the lord of the atmosphere; [may Soma protect you. We know you; know us. You are the overlord — make me the overlord of cattle, horses, men, students of sacred knowledge, of prosperity and the eating] of food.

sanskrit: sūryo divo adhipatiḥ somas tvāvatu vidma tvā viddhi mā | adhipatir asy adhipatiṃ mā kṛṇu gavām aśvānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ bhūtyā annādyasya ||
english: The sun is the lord of the sky; may Soma protect you. We know you; know us. You are the overlord — make me the overlord of cattle, horses, men, students of sacred knowledge, of prosperity and the eating of food.

sanskrit: vindad vasavo vindantu me gṛhān prajāṃ paśūn vittiṃ bhūtiṃ pratiṣṭhām ||
english: O Vasu who finds — may the Vasus find for me: houses, progeny, cattle, wealth, prosperity, and firm establishment.

sanskrit: āyadvasava ā yantu me gṛhāḥ prajāḥ paśavo vittir bhūtiḥ pratiṣṭhā ||
english: O Vasu who brings hither — may there come to me: houses, progeny, cattle, wealth, prosperity, and firm establishment.

sanskrit: saṃyad vasavaḥ saṃ yantu me gṛhāḥ | prajāḥ paśavo vittir bhūtiḥ pratiṣṭhā ||
english: O Vasus who unite — may there come together to me: houses, progeny, cattle, wealth, prosperity, and firm establishment.

sanskrit: jitir asi jīyāsaṃ pārthvīḥ pṛtanā jīyāsam ||
english: You are conquest — may I conquer; may I conquer the earthly armies.

sanskrit: vijitir asi vi jeṣīya mānuṣīḥ pṛtanā jīyāsam ||
english: You are victory — may I be victorious; may I conquer the human armies.

sanskrit: saṃjitir asi saṃ jīyāsaṃ sarvāḥ pṛtanā jīyāsam ||
english: You are complete conquest — may I conquer completely; may I conquer all armies.

sanskrit: bodhayainaṃ pra bodhaya svaptave mānu manyathāḥ | ūrdhvas tiṣṭhān mamādhyā nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāś cana ||
english: Awaken him, fully awaken him; do not think him fit for sleeping. Let him stand upright, thinking only of me — let him not even mention other women.

sanskrit: ā vartaya ni vartaya- -abhy ā vartayā kuru | idam asya sarvā cittāni smareṇa pra jayāmasi ||
english: Turn him toward me, turn him back, bring him around fully — do this. With the god of love, we conquer all his thoughts.

sanskrit: smaraṃ tapanti marutaḥ samiddhe jātavedasi | ud asya patatāṃ manas tad asya ramatāṃ mayi ||
english: The Maruts heat up love-longing in the kindled Jātavedas. May his mind fly upward and come to rest in me.

sanskrit: gaṇapate gaṇapatiṃ mā kṛṇu tasmān mā yavam ||
english: O lord of the troop, make me lord of the troop; do not take me away from it like barley.

sanskrit: apigaṇāpigaṇaṃ mā kṛṇu tasmān mā chitsi ||
english: O one who is joined to the troop, join me to the troop; do not cut me off from it.

sanskrit: sagaṇa sagaṇaṃ mā kṛṇu tasmān mā naśam ||
english: O one who has a troop, make me one who has a troop; may I not be lost from it.

sanskrit: gaṇavardhana gaṇaṃ me vardhaya gavām aśvānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ brahmacāriṇāṃ bhūtyā annādyasya ||
english: O increaser of the troop, increase my troop of cattle, horses, men, students of sacred knowledge, of prosperity and the eating of food.

sanskrit: gaṇābhivardhana gaṇaṃ me 'bhi vardhaya gavām (…) annādyasya ||
english: O abundant increaser of the troop, increase my troop abundantly — [cattle, horses, men, students of sacred knowledge, of prosperity and the eating] of food.

sanskrit: gaṇapravardhana gaṇaṃ me pra vardhaya gavām aśvānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ brahmacāriṇām bhūtyā annādyasya ||
english: O great increaser of the troop, greatly increase my troop of cattle, horses, men, students of sacred knowledge, of prosperity and the eating of food.

sanskrit: yac ca khātaṃ yac cākhātaṃ sarvaṃ tad arasaṃ viṣam ||
english: Whatever poison is dug up and whatever is not dug up — all that poison is rendered tasteless.

sanskrit: yac ca piṣṭaṃ yac cāpiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ tad arasaṃ viṣam ||
english: Whatever poison is ground up and whatever is not ground up — all that poison is rendered tasteless.

sanskrit: yac ca digdhaṃ yac cādigdhaṃ sarvaṃ tad arasaṃ viṣam ||
english: Whatever poison is smeared on and whatever is not smeared on — all that poison is rendered tasteless.

sanskrit: yathā vṛkī jagdhaputrā vyāghrī vālalā bhavet | evā tvam alalā bhava- -ādhībhiḥ preṣito mama ||
english: As a she-wolf whose cubs have been devoured, or a tigress, would become frenzied with distress — even so become frenzied, sent by my anxious longing.

sanskrit: yathā dīptaṃ śaratūlam agninālalā bhavet | evā tvam alalā bhava- -ādhībhiḥ preṣito mama ||
english: As the blazing tuft of autumn grass would be set wildly afire — even so become wildly agitated, sent by my anxious longing.

sanskrit: ā krandayālalā bhava dasya kāmena śuṣya ca | ādhībhiḥ preṣito mama ||
english: Cause him to cry out, become frenzied; wither with desire for me. Sent by my anxious longing.
